pages.title: Terms and conditions
sections: 1. Who we are
Gulf Content Co. is the trading name of TBC, a company registered in TBC under licence number TBC, with its registered office at TBC. We write copy to order through gulfcontentco.com.
You can reach us at hello@gulfcontentco.com. These terms apply to every order placed on this website, so please read them before you check out.
2. Your account
You need a free account to order. Keep your login details private, and tell us straight away if you think someone else has used your account. You are responsible for orders placed through it.
3. Ordering and prices

Each piece is priced by the options you choose in the calculator: length, grade of writer, turnaround, number of pieces and extra images. The full price is shown in your basket before you pay, and that is the price you are charged.

Prices are shown in US dollars (USD), Bahraini dinars (BHD) or UAE dirhams (AED), depending on the currency you select. An order is accepted once payment has cleared and we have emailed you an order confirmation.
4. Payment and billing
You pay the full amount once, at checkout, by card through our payment provider. We never see or store your full card details. Nothing renews and there is no subscription.

Billing descriptor: payments appear on your bank or card statement as TBC. If you see a charge you don't recognize, email us before contacting your bank and we will look into it within 2 working days.
5. Your brief

You send your brief before checkout. It should include everything the writer needs: the topic, the reader, the tone, any must-have details and any files you already have. You confirm you have the right to share any material you send us.
If a brief is missing key information, we will ask for it. The turnaround clock pauses until we receive your answer.
6. Delivery
Work starts once your payment has cleared and your brief is complete. Standard turnaround takes 5 to 7 days; Express takes 2 to 3 days. Both are counted from that point.

Your draft is delivered electronically to your account, and we email you when it is ready. Nothing is posted. A piece counts as delivered when the draft appears in your account. If we expect to miss a deadline, we will tell you before it passes and give you a new date, and you may cancel for a full refund instead.
7. Changes to your draft

Two rounds of changes come with every piece, requested through your account within 14 days of delivery. Changes must stay within the original brief. A new topic, angle or length counts as a new order.
If you request no changes within 14 days, the piece is treated as accepted.
8. Cancellation
You can cancel any order before your writer starts work by emailing hello@gulfcontentco.com or using the cancel option on that order in your account. You will receive a full refund.

Once writing has begun, an order can no longer be cancelled, because the work is made to your brief. If you cancel an order in progress for a reason that is our fault, such as a missed deadline, you will receive a full refund.
9. Refunds
We give a full refund if you cancel before writing begins, if we cannot take on your brief, or if we miss the agreed delivery date and you choose not to wait.

If a delivered piece does not follow your brief and both rounds of changes have not put it right, you may ask for a partial or full refund. Email hello@gulfcontentco.com within 14 days of delivery with your order number and what is wrong. We will reply within 5 working days.

Approved refunds are paid back to the original payment method within 5 to 10 working days. Refunds are not given for changes of mind after writing has started or for requests outside the original brief.
10. Ownership of the work

Once you have paid in full, the finished copy belongs to you. You may use, edit and publish it however you like, under your own name or without credit to us. Licensed images supplied with a piece may be used under the terms of their licence, which we pass on to you.
Until payment is complete, the copy remains ours.
11. What we will not write

We may decline any brief that asks for false or unverifiable claims, invented experience, copied material, or content that is unlawful, defamatory or misleading. If we decline a brief after you have paid, you will receive a full refund.
12. Liability

We take care to check facts, but you are responsible for reviewing the copy before you publish it, including any legal or regulatory statements. Our total liability for any order is limited to the amount you paid for it.
We are not liable for indirect losses such as lost profit or lost business. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law.
13. Your personal data
Your details are used to process and deliver your order. Our Privacy Policy explains what we collect, why, and the choices you have.
14. Complaints
If you are unhappy with anything, email hello@gulfcontentco.com with your order number. We will acknowledge your complaint within 2 working days and give you a full response within 10 working days.
15. Governing law
These terms are governed by the laws of TBC. Any dispute that we cannot settle between us will be handled by the courts of TBC.
16. Changes to these terms
We may update these terms from time to time. The version in force when you place an order applies to that order. The date at the top of this page shows when they last changed.

pages.title: Privacy policy
sections: 1. Who we are

Gulf Content Co. is the trading name of TBC, registered in TBC under licence number TBC, with its registered office at TBC. We are responsible for the personal data described here. For any privacy question, email hello@gulfcontentco.com.
2. What we collect
Account details: your name, email address, phone number if you give it, and your password (stored encrypted).
Order details: your briefs, the files you upload, your drafts, change requests and messages with us.
Payment records: the amount, currency, date and status of each payment. Your card details go directly to our payment provider and never reach us.
Writer applications: your name, contact details, sectors, samples and message, if you apply to write for us.
Website data: your IP address, browser and device type, and the pages you visit, collected through cookies.
3. How we use it

We use your data to run your account, deliver your orders, take payment, send order emails, answer your questions and keep records we are required to keep by law. With your consent, we use cookies to measure how the site is used so we can improve it. We do not sell your data and we do not use your briefs for anything except your order.
4. Who we share it with

Your brief and files are shared only with the writer and editor working on your order, who are bound by confidentiality. We also use trusted providers for payment processing, website hosting, email delivery and site analytics. Each one only receives what it needs to do its job.
We will share data with authorities only when the law requires it.
5. Where it is stored
Some of our providers store data outside the country you live in. Where that happens, we make sure appropriate safeguards are in place to protect it.
6. How long we keep it

We keep your account and order records while your account is open and for TBC years afterwards, to meet tax and legal requirements. Writer applications that do not go ahead are deleted after 12 months. You can ask us to delete your account at any time.
7. Cookies

Essential cookies keep you logged in and keep your basket working. Analytics cookies are only set if you agree to them, and you can change your choice at any time from the cookie settings link in the footer.
8. Your rights
You can ask us for a copy of your data, ask us to correct or delete it, object to how we use it, or withdraw your consent to cookies. Email hello@gulfcontentco.com and we will respond within 30 days.
If you are not satisfied with our answer, you can complain to the data protection authority in TBC.
9. Keeping it safe
Your data is sent over encrypted connections, access is limited to the people who need it, and passwords are stored encrypted.
10. Children
This website is not intended for anyone under 18, and we do not knowingly collect their data.
11. Governing law
This policy is governed by the data protection laws of TBC.
12. Changes to this policy
We may update this policy. The date at the top of this page shows the latest version, and we will email you about any significant change.
